source.path: OpenAI_and_LLMs/Chat Assistant (OpenAI assistant) with Postgres Memory And API Calling Capabalities.json

setup: "Chat Trigger" (chatTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

hints: Provide `chatInput` (and optionally `sessionId`) as run inputs; the original started from a chat message.
"OpenAI" kept conversation memory (memoryPostgresChat); sessionId is set to the run-input sessionId.
"OpenAI2" kept conversation memory (memoryPostgresChat); sessionId is set to the run-input sessionId.

"OpenAI2" used agent tools in the original: External API (toolHttpRequest), Knowledge Base (toolHttpRequest), Products in Daatabase (mySqlTool). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached. Prefer connectors: clickhouse.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect clickhouse: `cdecli credential create -n "clickhouse" -p clickhouse --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
